data.provider: Tardis public monthly-first-day normalized quote files

hypothesis: A completed 100ms Bybit inverse-perpetual BTCUSD/ETHUSD BBO displacement and prior-basis SMT divergence can lead the executable same-venue BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT linear-perpetual quote.
promotion: A survivor only authorizes development of a causal state exit; it is not rank eligible and does not open 2024.

signal.prior_basis: segmented prior-only EWM of log(linear mid)-log(inverse mid); span 600; minimum 300; reset after unavailable joint state

smc_ict_translation.displacement: inverse BTCUSD/ETHUSD contract moves first on completed information
smc_ict_translation.entry: take the linear contract toward rebalance only while at least half the causal gap remains after latency
smc_ict_translation.fair_value_gap: prior-basis-adjusted inverse/linear price gap is the measurable inter-contract imbalance
smc_ict_translation.invalidation: no entry after the linear contract reprices through more than half the gap or the marketable limit is breached
smc_ict_translation.smt_divergence: linear BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT contract has not confirmed the inverse-contract move
